description: A-1 stage 3 exterior geometry corrections for CAP 487, applied to the pinned donor mesh at load time by both the converter and the measurement harness. Every entry names the dimension it closes, the sourced target, and why this transform was chosen. Corrections are deliberately parametric and version-controlled here rather than baked into a mesh, because the donor mesh is GPL and stays outside this repository (docs/FLIGHTGEAR_C182_GPL_PLAN.md).

corrections.rationale: TCDS 3A13 gives the McCauley B3D36C431/80VSA-1 a certification band of 77.5-79.0 in; the donor measured 79.255 in, outside it. This is a certification bound, not a tolerance, so the value must move. A radial scale about the existing propeller axis was chosen over clipping the blade tips because it preserves topology, vertex count, UVs and the hub position exactly, and at 0.32 percent the difference between scaling and trimming is under a third of a millimetre at the tip. FastProp, the blur disc, is scaled with the blades so the spinning propeller still matches the static one. chrome_spinner is deliberately NOT scaled: the spinner diameter is not the propeller diameter.
corrections.preserves: Hub position and rotation axis are unchanged by construction, because the transform only scales the component perpendicular to that axis. No animation pivot moves, so converter.PROP_ROTATION needs no recomputation.
corrections.source: TCDS 3A13 p.33 Propeller Limits, 182S/182T item (2); POH p.1-3 front view annotates 79" MAX
